s01D7F1.name: Line guide engine and platform sprites
summary: Shared code for the line-guided sprites ($62-$68: brown/checker platforms, rope motor, chainsaws, grinder, fuzz ball).
Sprite state ([$C2]): 0 = at a segment end, search for the next line tile ($01D7F4); 1 = follow the segment (CODE_01D768);
2 = fell off a line and flies with its own speed ($01DB44). The chunk holds the search, the Map16 lookup ($01D94D),
the per-sprite dispatcher ($01D9A7), the rope/Mario grab code ($01D9D3) and the platform code ($01DAA2).
Line tiles are Map16 $76-$99: tile - $76 is the segment number [$160E] indexing the tables at $01DCD1-$01DD89.

s01DB5A.name: Table: grinder X speed by direction

Grinder.name: Sprite B4: Grinder (not line-guided)
summary: Draws the grinder, then (status 8, sprites not locked) plays its sound every 4th frame, hurts Mario on contact,
walks left/right at $18/$E8 with gravity and turns around at walls.

s01DB96.name: Table: grinder OAM offsets and properties

s01DBA2.name: Grinder and fuzz ball graphics
summary: $01DBA2: draws the grinder as four 16x16 tiles ($6C/$6E animated). $01DBD4: draws the fuzz ball as one 16x16 tile ($C8),
shifted up and left by 8. Both end in FinishOAMWriteRt with Y = 2 (16x16).

s01DC0B.name: Line-guided grinder graphics
summary: Draws the line-guided grinder as four 16x16 tiles ($6C/$6E animated), then shares the finish code at $01DBD0.

LineGuideRopeTiles.name: Rope mechanism graphics and tile table
summary: Rope tile table, then the draw routine at $01DC54: a motor tile on top (animated from RopeMotorTiles) and a vertical
rope of $CE tiles below, ending in a $DE tile. 5 tiles normally, 9 if [$1692] is set and the sprite slot is 6 or higher.

s01DCD1.name: Table: line segment step counts
summary: Indexed by segment number (Map16 tile - $76). Number of steps the sprite takes along the segment ([$1570]).

s01DCF1.name: Table: line segment slope type
summary: 0 = measure position by X, 1 = by Y from the opposite edge, 2 = by Y. Used to decide the direction of travel.

s01DD11.name: Table: Y speed when leaving a line
summary: 64 entries: 32 segments forward, then 32 backward. Doubled (x4 if negative) when a sprite falls off the end.

s01DD51.name: Table: X speed when leaving a line
summary: Same layout as the Y speed table; doubled when the sprite falls off the line end.

s01DD90.name: Table: bonus game sprite start data
summary: Start X, Y and direction for the ten bonus game sprite slots (slots 1-9 used).

InitBonusGame.name: Sprite 82: Init bonus game
summary: First instance spawns nine more copies of sprite $82 in slots 9-1 at positions from the tables, sets their directions
and animation phase, picks a random starting value into [$1579] and sets [$1B94]. Later calls just erase themselves.
